definitions.gloss: to turn off, to switch off
definitions.explanation: To deactivate electrical devices like lights, TV, or air conditioning.
To remove writing, data, or marks.

examples.japanese: {電気|でんき}を{消|け}してください。
テレビを{消|け}しましょうか？
examples.english: Shall I turn off the TV?

examples.japanese: {黒板|こくばん}の{字|じ}を{消|け}してください。
examples.english: Please erase the writing on the blackboard.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pair: {消|き}える (intransitive, to go out/disappear). Pattern: Xを{消|け}す (turn off/erase X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {消|け}している = 'have turned off' or 'is erasing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{電気|でんき}を{消|け}す (turn off the light)
・テレビを{消|け}す (turn off the TV)
・{字|じ}を{消|け}す (erase writing)
・{火|ひ}を{消|け}す (put out a fire)

Opposite for devices: つける (to turn on). Pair: {消|き}える (to go out by itself).
